title: TV and visibility comments
summary: The topic clusters around scattered comments about TV availability, hearing or wind noise, and visibility, with many fragments too brief or context-light to support a clear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car in general and mention confidence in recommending it, with one fragment also noting better traffic visibility from the higher driving position.

negative.summary: Negative reviews express overall dissatisfaction and specifically criticize the inability to watch TV as a drawback.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention issues such as not being able to view TV, hear properly, see controls or the reverse camera clearly, adjust steering feel, or hearing wind noise, but the short excerpts do not always make the sentiment explicit.

limitations: This cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including TV functions, hearing or wind noise, visibility, and steering adjustment, rather than one clearly coherent issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined and very short, so examples are insufficient to infer a more specific common concern.
One supplied fragment assigned to a positive review has undetermined fragment sentiment, so positive evidence is limited to the clearly positive fragments only.
